title: DEKALB 9244S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete corn (DK 9244S): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics

metaDescription: DEKALB 9244S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
keywords: DEKALB 9244S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete corn variety
excerpt: DEKALB 9244S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as DK 9244S or Dekalb 9244S. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2025 as NSIC 2025 GMCn 97. Bayer Cropscience bred it. It takes about 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 7.17 tonnes per hectare in the trials (7.22 in Luzon, 7.11 in Mindanao).

blocks.caption: From the NSIC registry and its seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

DEKALB 9244S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete corn takes about 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 7.17 t/ha trails the average of its group, 8.13. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives 115 to 120 days, 104 to 105 in NSIC trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 15.8 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 76.18 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** Potential 8.3 t/ha (company says higher than rival hybrids in its class), NSIC trials averaged 7.22 t/ha Luzon and 7.11 Mindanao.
**Traits in the seed:** VT Double PRO with Roundup Ready (MON 89034 x NK603): two Bt proteins against Asian corn borer, earworm, cutworm and fall armyworm, plus glyphosate (Roundup) tolerance.
**Where:** Mindanao: BARMM and Banisilan, Cotabato.
Yellow orange flint grain, 16 to 18 rows.
Semi erect plant with stay green leaves, ear set medium high.
Good standability and grain quality.
Good tolerance to Diplodia ear rot.
Leaf disease package: banded leaf and sheath blight, brown spot, white spot, Diplodia leaf blight, border leaf blight.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: listed by Bayer Philippines as a current hybrid aimed at farmers in BARMM and Cotabato. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual corn on the same ground.
Where and when to plant DEKALB 9244S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete corn

The registry recommends it for Luzon and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is DK 9244S the same as DEKALB 9244S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete?
items.a: Yes. DK 9244S is another name for DEKALB 9244S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete, registered as NSIC 2025 GMCn 97. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 7.17 tonnes per hectare in the trials (7.22 in Luzon, 7.11 in Mindanao). Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
The registry recommends it for Luzon and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of DEKALB 9244S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
